selection.summary: Implemented fixes for NodeBB v4.4.3 dropdown issues. (1) public/src/modules/notifications.js (h4, h18): added a token-based guard in Notifications.loadNotifications so stale async 'notifications.get' responses are discarded, preventing race conditions where an older response overwrites the newest notifications list when the dropdown is opened (triggered via 'show.bs.dropdown' in public/src/client/header/notifications.js, h9). (2) public/src/client/topic/fork.js (h3) and public/src/client/topic/move.js (h5, h19): after categorySelector.init on the fork/move modal's [component="category-selector"] (templates h0, h2, partial h10), the 'dropup' class is now removed, so the category menu in these modals renders with correct placement and stable interaction. threadTools dropup toggling (h1) applies only to the thread tools menu and was intentionally left unchanged.

native_export.selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.

sidecar.claim_ceiling: Confirmed delivery and declared final selection only; neither proves semantic use.

source_projection.claim_ceiling: Only exact unchanged source lines map to base coordinates. Changed/inserted lines receive no base-context credit.
